packages.name: @hono/node-server
relevant_topics: serveStatic from '@hono/node-server/serve-static' for the built SPA
doc_omissions: serveStatic root is resolved relative to process.cwd(); the docs do not emphasize this, which matters because db:reset/e2e scripts assume the package root as cwd.

packages.name: better-auth
relevant_topics: passing a better-sqlite3 Database instance as `database`
programmatic schema migration via better-auth/db/migration getMigrations(...).runMigrations()
server-side auth.api.* returning plain objects (not Response)
trustedOrigins + CSRF origin checks on cookie POSTs
doc_omissions: 1.7.18 does NOT auto-create its tables when given a database connection: first use throws SchemaMismatchError (SCHEMA_MISMATCH) telling you to run the CLI. The programmatic path (better-auth/db/migration -> getMigrations(auth.options) -> runMigrations()) is under-documented.
During first-time table creation runMigrations() logs a transient 'Database schema mismatch ... Missing tables' ERROR even though creation then succeeds; subsequent boots are clean. Not documented.
Server-side auth.api.signUpEmail returns the created user object directly, while the HTTP endpoint returns { token, user }; docs do not call this asymmetry out.
POST /api/auth/sign-out with a JSON content-type but empty body returns 400; docs do not mention that a body is expected.
createAuthClient() origin inference: docs describe an explicit baseURL pattern; same-origin inference works but the default-host behavior is easy to misconfigure silently.
Docs present Kysely as the custom-database path; passing a better-sqlite3 instance directly also works in 1.7.18 (verified) but is thinly documented.
